parts.label: (i)
parts.answer: The lines are neither parallel nor intersecting, so they are skew.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Equate at least two pairs of components and solve for $s$ or $t$ — M1. Official examples are $s=- rac43,t=- rac53$ with $-5
e- rac13$; $s=-6,t=-11$ with $7
e-7$; or $s=- rac25,t=- rac{13}5$ with $ rac65
e- rac85$. Obtain a correct answer for $s$ or $t$, e.g. $s=-6,t=-11$ — A1. Verify that all three equations are not satisfied and the lines fail to intersect — A1. State that the lines are not parallel — B1. Total: 4.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.answer: $5\mathbf i-3\mathbf j+\mathbf k$, or any non-zero scalar multiple.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: EITHER use scalar products to obtain a relevant equation in $a,b,c$, e.g. $2a+3b-c=0$ — B1; obtain a second, e.g. $a+2b+c=0$, and solve for one ratio — M1; obtain $a:b:c$ and state $5\mathbf i-3\mathbf j+\mathbf k$, or equivalent — A1. OR attempt $(2\mathbf i+3\mathbf j-\mathbf k)\times(\mathbf i+2\mathbf j+\mathbf k)$ — M1; obtain two correct components — A1; obtain $5\mathbf i-3\mathbf j+\mathbf k$ — A1. Total: 3.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: EITHER state the position vector or coordinates of the midpoint of a segment joining points on $l$ and $m$, e.g. $\frac32\mathbf i+\mathbf j+\frac52\mathbf k$ — B1; use the result of part (ii) and the midpoint to find $d$ — M1; obtain $5x-3y+z=7$, or equivalent — A1. Official guidance alternative: use the result of part (ii) to form equations of planes containing $l$ and $m$ — B1; use the average of distances to find the equation of $p$ — M1; obtain the same equation — A1. OR, using part (ii), form an equation in $d$ by equating perpendicular distances to the plane of a point on $l$ and a point on $m$ — M1; state a correct equation, e.g. $\frac{|14-d|}{\sqrt{35}}=\frac{|-d|}{\sqrt{35}}$ — A1; solve for $d$ and obtain $5x-3y+z=7$, or equivalent — A1. Total: 3.
